name: Website Feature Change
description: Add or change interactive functionality on the tachin.ai website — forms, navigation behavior, animations with logic, third-party embeds, build pipeline changes. For behavior, not pure visuals (use p-web-design) or pure copy (use p-web-content).

goal.description: The feature or functionality to build

steps.title: Verify feature against the design system and IA
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP — do NOT modify anything.

Verify the feature ${goal}:
1. Confirm any UI it introduces uses design-system tokens and documented components.
2. Confirm it matches the page's purpose in docs/design/TACHIN_SITE_IA.md.
3. Confirm graceful behavior with JS disabled where feasible (progressive enhancement).
4. Confirm responsive behavior at 375 / 768 / 1280.
5. Confirm no console errors and no broken links.
steps.accept_criteria: Feature uses design-system UI, matches IA, is responsive, and produces no console errors.

steps.title: Owner review
steps.description: Present the feature and verification results to the owner.
steps.approval_message: ⚙️ Feature ready: ${goal}. Review and reply approve or reject.
